name: veritasgraph
description: Zero-trust, air-gapped GraphRAG: citation-grounded answers from a local knowledge graph.
long_description: VeritasGraph builds a knowledge graph from your documents with a local Ollama model and answers questions with multi-hop reasoning and verifiable [doc#chunk] citations. It abstains when the graph has no evidence, records an answer receipt for every response, and keeps all data on your machine.

model.title: Ollama model
model.description: Local model used for extraction and answers.

mode.title: Tool mode
mode.description: Which tools to expose: read (query only), write (adds ingest and term proposals) or admin (adds import and clear).

data_dir.title: Data directory
data_dir.description: Where the knowledge graph is stored.

tools.name: veritasgraph_check_answerable
tools.description: Check whether the knowledge graph covers a question before asking it.

tools.name: veritasgraph_query
tools.description: Graph-grounded, multi-hop answer with [doc#chunk] citations and an answer_id receipt.

tools.name: veritasgraph_search_entities
tools.description: Retrieve the subgraph most relevant to a query without calling the LLM.

tools.name: veritasgraph_get_entity
tools.description: One entity with neighbours, source chunks and glossary terms.

tools.name: veritasgraph_get_graph
tools.description: The full knowledge graph: nodes, edges and stats.

tools.name: veritasgraph_get_ontology
tools.description: Entity types, predicates and glossary terms with their status.

tools.name: veritasgraph_get_term
tools.description: One glossary term with definition, synonyms and linked entities.

tools.name: veritasgraph_get_answer_receipt
tools.description: Receipt for a previous answer: evidence, grounding and graph version.

tools.name: veritasgraph_compile_status
tools.description: Last ontology compile run and open curation suggestions.

tools.name: veritasgraph_structured_search
tools.description: Search the structured-data catalog. No SQL is run.

tools.name: veritasgraph_structured_list_measures
tools.description: Named SQL measures with expression and review status.

tools.name: veritasgraph_structured_ask
tools.description: Answer from connected databases with one validated, read-only SQL query.

tools.name: veritasgraph_ingest_document
tools.description: Ingest a document into the knowledge graph with source-chunk provenance.

tools.name: veritasgraph_import_graph
tools.description: Import a pre-built graph (Graphify, Understand-Anything, AI Atlas or node/edge JSON).

tools.name: veritasgraph_propose_term
tools.description: Propose a glossary term for admin certification.

tools.name: veritasgraph_clear_graph
tools.description: Clear the knowledge graph (a snapshot is taken first).

prompts.name: grounded_answer
prompts.description: Answer a question only from the knowledge graph, citing [doc#chunk] sources.
prompts.text:
Answer this question using only the VeritasGraph knowledge graph: ${arguments.question}

1. Call veritasgraph_check_answerable. If it is not answerable, say so and stop.
2. Call veritasgraph_query and quote its [doc#chunk] citations.
3. If grounded is false or abstained is true, say the answer is unverified.
4. End with the answer_id so the answer can be audited later.

prompts.name: verify_claim
prompts.description: Check a statement against the knowledge graph and report supporting evidence.
prompts.text:
Verify this claim against the VeritasGraph knowledge graph: ${arguments.claim}

Use veritasgraph_search_entities to find the entities involved, then veritasgraph_query to test the claim. Reply with one of SUPPORTED, CONTRADICTED or NOT IN GRAPH, followed by the [doc#chunk] citations that justify it. Do not use outside knowledge.

prompts.name: explore_entity
prompts.description: Summarise an entity, its relationships and the sources behind them.
prompts.text: Use veritasgraph_get_entity for "${arguments.entity}" and summarise what the knowledge graph says about it: its type, its most important relationships, any glossary terms linked to it, and the source chunks that back each fact.
